verdicts.title: Keyphrase Generation Beyond the Boundaries of Title and Abstract
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Keyphrase generation aims at generating important phrases (keyphrases) that best describe a given document. In scholarly domains, current approaches have largely used only the title and abstract of the articles to generate keyphrases. verdicts.title: The effect of a country's name in the title of a publication on its visibility and citability
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The objective of this research is to determine if the reference to a country in the title, keywords or abstract of a publication can influence its visibility (measured by the impact factor of the publishing journal) and citability (measured by the citations received). verdicts.title: TiAb Review Plugin: A Browser-Based Tool for AI-Assisted Title and Abstract Screening
